title: Map app
description: A map-first app: full-bleed Map with floating panels for the list and the selected item, markers that cluster, areas, filters, and every loading, empty and error state

quality.map: The Map fills the screen (fill, height="100dvh"); lists and details float over it as panels (background="surface", border, radius="l", shadow="l", position="absolute" with offsets), never a map in a card beside a table
quality.markers: MapMarkers with cluster and activeId; MapPin tone carries status with a text label too; selecting in the list frames the item on the map
quality.identity: Logo in the panel header; status as Tags with tone and words, urgent ones danger
quality.phone: On a phone the list panel becomes a bottom sheet (s={{ … }} on the panel) or a Drawer; the map stays full-bleed
quality.states: Every view that loads data shows loading (Skeleton shaped like the content), empty (title, one line, the action that fills it), error (Feedback tone="danger" with Retry) and filled, through a typed lib/ data layer of async functions over mock data — even when the brief never mentions data
quality.writes: Writes are optimistic: loading on the pressed Button, rollback plus addToast({ tone: "danger" }) when the save fails
